title: Forensic Recitation Gate & Mobile UX Remediation Audit

root_cause_analysis.mechanism_explanation: The condition normalizedExpected.includes(normalizedObserved) evaluated to true whenever the observed string was a substring of the expected Quranic word. In Zipformer CTC streaming decoding, unvoiced humming or ambient noise frequently emits solitary consonant tokens like 'م' or 'ل'. Because 'بسم' contains 'م', 'بسم'.includes('م') evaluated to true, classifying noise/humming as MATCH and advancing the recitation word cursor.
root_cause_analysis.token_leakage_vulnerability: CTC streaming decoder state was not reset between target words, allowing tail tokens from prior speech or acoustic artifacts to bleed into subsequent evaluation windows.

normalization_rules: Strip Quranic Tajweed honorifics and recitation marks (U+06D6 to U+06ED)
Normalize Alef variants (إ, أ, آ, ٱ) to standard Bare Alef (ا)
Strip all Tashkeel/Harakat (Fathah, Dammah, Kasrah, Sukun, Tanween, Shaddah)
Trim whitespace and collapse internal spaces
advancement_gate_specification.matching_algorithm: Levenshtein distance with similarity ratio >= 0.85 and discrete token boundary match

CASE_G_TOKEN_LEAKAGE.mechanism: InferenceWorkerClient.resetSession invoked immediately on verified word match
